data.content:
* * *

![Image 1: Rated 1 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-1.svg)

Apr 9, 2023

## [Not Happy with Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/64331899746ca7dfea062567)
I placed an order with Lulu and Georgia on March 26th. They charged my credit card. I got a confirmation email of my order, but never got a shipping confirmation. So I tried calling them. No phone number for customer service so I had to do a chat. Emily from the chat said it can take up to 7-10 days for an order to be processed for shipping. Today is April 9th. They are asking me to "review" my product and it hasn't even shipped. I would give Lulu and Georgia and "F" for customer service an follow through. I would like to get the pillows I ordered.

March 26, 2023

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Apr 10, 2023

Hi Lisa,

Thank you for your patience. It's taking our warehouse more time than expected to process orders, but your order is on track to ship by this week.

We sincerely apologize for this delay and were actively working on getting these orders fulfilled as soon as possible. If you have any further questions or concerns, please reach out to support@luluandgeorgia.com.
